title: Auto envvar applied to empty envvar
detail: The check `if not envvar` treats empty strings and empty lists as falsy, causing the auto_envvar_prefix logic to run even when an explicit empty envvar was provided. This results in an unintended envvar being shown in help.
note: About the auto-envvar assignment above the planted line; the PR's own logic.

title: Incorrect header name normalization
detail: The loop sets `name = "Content-Type"` when the original header name is not exactly "content-type" (case-insensitive). This means any custom header like "X-Custom-Header" will be overwritten to "Content-Type", losing the original header and potentially causing duplicate or missing headers.
note: Describes the planted flip: every other header is renamed to Content-Type.

title: Blocking read on keep‑alive connection
detail: When the connection is keep‑alive, the server calls `stream.read()` synchronously. If the request has no body, this call blocks forever, causing the server to hang. In the async version the call is awaited, but the sync version still blocks.
note: The read drains the body on purpose.
